t2.title: Schools require students to wear uniforms
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The topic is: "Should schools require students to wear uniforms?" Write your article, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
The Great Uniform Debate: Freedom vs. Unity

The question of whether schools should mandate uniforms has sparked endless discussions among students, parents, and educators alike. Both sides present compelling arguments.

Undeniably, school uniforms offer significant advantages. They create a sense of unity and belonging, helping students focus on learning rather than fashion. Moreover, uniforms eliminate socioeconomic distinctions, as all students dress similarly regardless of their family's financial background.

However, critics argue that uniforms stifle self-expression. Teenagers, in particular, are at a stage where developing their personal identity is crucial. Forcing them into identical clothing might hinder this natural process.

Furthermore, the cost of uniforms can be a burden for some families, especially when specific items must be purchased from designated suppliers.

Ultimately, a middle ground might be the solution. Schools could implement a basic dress code that maintains professional standards while allowing some personal choice. This way, both unity and individuality can coexist harmoniously.

t2.sampleA2:
Hello,
I think uniform is okay. It is easy to wear. But I want to wear my own clothes. My clothes are nice and I like them. Uniform is boring because it is the same every day. Maybe no uniform on Friday? That would be good. Thank you.

t2.sampleB1:
Should we have uniforms at school? I think it's a difficult question. On one hand, uniforms can be good because everyone looks the same. This means that people might not judge each other based on their clothes. Also, it's easier to decide what to wear in the morning!

However, I also think that uniforms stop us from showing our personality. We all want to be different and express ourselves, and clothes are a good way to do that. Maybe we could have a dress code instead of a strict uniform? That way, we could still have some rules but also have some freedom to choose our own style. In my opinion, a dress code is a good compromise.

Thank you for reading.
t2.sampleB2: To Wear or Not to Wear? Few topics divide a school quite like the humble uniform. Should students be made to wear one, or should they be free to dress as they please? It is a debate that never seems to go away. Supporters of uniforms make a strong case. When everyone wears the same outfit, nobody stands out for the wrong reasons, and expensive brands lose their power to divide us. A uniform also puts an end to the daily struggle of choosing an outfit, letting students focus on their lessons instead of their looks. On the other hand, critics argue that uniforms stamp out individuality. For teenagers, clothes are a way of showing who they are, and a rigid dress code can feel stifling. What's more, buying specific items from set suppliers can hit family budgets hard. So where does that leave us? In my view, the answer lies somewhere in the middle. A simple dress code, topped up with the odd free-dress day, would keep things fair while giving students room to breathe. That way, everyone wins.
t2.uzSample:
Forma masalasi: Erkinlik va birlik

Maktablar forma kiyishni majburiy qilish kerakmi degan savol talabalar, ota-onalar va o'qituvchilar o'rtasida tinimsiz bahslarga sabab bo'ldi. Ikkala tomon ham ishonarli dalillarni keltirmoqda.

Shubhasiz, maktab formalari sezilarli afzalliklarni taqdim etadi. Ular birlik va mansublik tuyg'usini yaratadi, bu esa talabalarga moda emas, balki o'qishga e'tibor qaratishga yordam beradi. Bundan tashqari, formalar ijtimoiy-iqtisodiy farqlarni yo'q qiladi, chunki barcha talabalar oilasining moliyaviy ahvolidan qat'i nazar, bir xil kiyinadi.

Biroq, tanqidchilarning ta'kidlashicha, formalar o'zini ifoda etishni cheklaydi. Ayniqsa, o'smirlar o'z shaxsiyatini rivojlantirish muhim bo'lgan bosqichda bo'ladi. Ularni bir xil kiyim kiyishga majburlash bu tabiiy jarayonga to'sqinlik qilishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, formalar narxi ba'zi oilalar uchun, ayniqsa, muayyan narsalarni belgilangan yetkazib beruvchilardan sotib olish kerak bo'lganda, og'irlik qilishi mumkin.

Oxir oqibat, o'rtacha yo'l yechim bo'lishi mumkin. Maktablar professional standartlarni saqlab qolgan holda, shaxsiy tanlovga imkon beradigan asosiy kiyim kodini joriy qilishi mumkin. Shu tarzda, ham birlik, ham individuallik uyg'un tarzda mavjud bo'lishi mumkin.

Salom!
Menga forma yoqadi. Bu oson. O'ylash yo'q. Forma yaxshi. Xayr.
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,
Menimcha, forma yaxshi. Uni kiyish oson. Lekin men o'z kiyimlarimni kiyishni xohlayman. Mening kiyimlarim chiroyli va menga yoqadi. Forma zerikarli, chunki u har kuni bir xil. Balki jumada forma bo'lmasligi kerak? Bu yaxshi bo'lardi. Rahmat.
Xayr.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Maktabda forma kiyishimiz kerakmi? Menimcha, bu qiyin savol. Bir tomondan, forma yaxshi bo'lishi mumkin, chunki hamma bir xil ko'rinadi. Bu odamlar bir-birini kiyimlari asosida baholamasligi mumkin degani. Bundan tashqari, ertalab nima kiyishni hal qilish osonroq!

Biroq, menimcha, forma bizning shaxsiyatimizni ko'rsatishimizga ham to'sqinlik qiladi. Hammamiz har xil bo'lishni va o'zimizni ifoda etishni xohlaymiz va kiyimlar buni qilishning yaxshi usuli. Balki qattiq forma o'rniga kiyim kodi bo'lishi mumkin? Shunday qilib, bizda hali ham ba'zi qoidalar bo'lishi mumkin, lekin o'z uslubimizni tanlashda ham erkinlikka ega bo'lishimiz mumkin. Mening fikrimcha, kiyim kodi yaxshi murosadir.

O'qiganingiz uchun rahmat.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Maktab formasi atrofidagi bahslar talabalar uchun dolzarb mavzu bo'lib qolmoqda. Hozirgi tizimni saqlab qolish foydasiga dalillar mavjud bo'lsa-da, menimcha, yanada moslashuvchan yondashuv oxir-oqibatda talabalar manfaatiga xizmat qiladi.

Forma tarafdorlari ko'pincha ularning tenglikni targ'ib qilish va diqqatni chalg'ituvchi omillarni kamaytirish qobiliyatini ta'kidlaydilar. Trendlarga moslashish bosimini yo'qotish orqali talabalar o'qishga ko'proq e'tibor qaratishlari mumkin. Bundan tashqari, forma hamjamiyat va mansublik tuyg'usini rivojlantirishi mumkin. Biroq, bu afzalliklar o'z narxiga ega.

Talabalardan bir xil kiyim kiyishni talab qilish individuallik va o'zini ifoda etishni bo'g'adi. O'smirlik - bu shaxsiyatni rivojlantirish uchun muhim davr va kiyim bu jarayonda muhim rol o'ynaydi. Bundan tashqari, muayyan forma buyumlarini sotib olishning moliyaviy yuklamasi ba'zi oilalar uchun sezilarli bo'lishi mumkin.

Potensial yechim professional ko'rinishni saqlab qolgan holda, shaxsiy tanlovga imkon beradigan erkin kiyim kodi bo'lishi mumkin. Bu talabalarga raqobat muhitini yaratmasdan, o'zlarini ijodiy ifoda etishga imkon beradi. Oxir-oqibat, maqsad inklyuziv va individual farqlarga hurmat bilan munosabatda bo'ladigan ta'lim muhitini yaratish bo'lishi kerak.

t12.title: formal message · to council
t12.prompt: Write a formal letter to the School Council responding to their message. Express your opinion on the uniform policy and provide reasons for your view.
t12.sample:
Dear School Council,

Thank you for inviting students to share their views on the uniform policy. I appreciate this opportunity to express my thoughts.

Personally, I believe a balanced approach would be most beneficial. While uniforms promote equality among students and reduce peer pressure regarding clothing, a completely strict policy can feel restrictive.

I would suggest introducing casual dress days once a week. This would allow students to express their individuality while maintaining the benefits of a uniform on other days.

Additionally, perhaps the uniform itself could be updated to include more comfortable options suitable for different weather conditions.

Thank you for considering student feedback on this important matter.

Yours sincerely,
A Concerned Student
t12.sampleA1:
Hi School Council,
I like uniform. It is easy. I don't like choosing clothes. My friends like uniform too. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Dear School Council,
I think the uniform is okay, but it's not very good. I like it because it's easy to wear, and I don't have to think about what to wear. But it's boring, and I want to wear my own clothes sometimes. Maybe we can have free dress days? That would be fun. Thank you.
From, A Student
t12.sampleB1:
Dear School Council,
I am writing to you about the school uniform. I think that the current uniform policy is mostly good, but there are some things that could be improved. For example, the uniform can be uncomfortable, especially in the summer. Also, I think students should have more opportunities to express themselves. I suggest we could have a 'dress down' day once a month. This would allow us to wear our own clothes and show our personality. However, I also understand the benefits of a uniform, like preventing bullying and making sure everyone looks smart. Thank you for listening to my opinion.
Sincerely,
A Student
t12.sampleB2: Dear School Council, Thank you for giving students the chance to share their views on the uniform policy. I would like to take this opportunity to put forward my thoughts. On the whole, I am in favour of a more relaxed approach. While the current uniform promotes equality and takes the pressure off choosing an outfit each morning, a strict policy can feel restrictive and leave little room for self-expression. For this reason, I would suggest introducing free-dress days once a week. This would strike a balance between keeping a smart, united appearance and allowing students to show their individuality. In addition, updating the uniform with more comfortable options would make it far more practical in different weather conditions. Thank you for taking student feedback into account. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova

Hurmatli Maktab Kengashi,

Talabalarni forma siyosati bo'yicha o'z fikrlarini bildirishga taklif qilganingiz uchun rahmat. O'z fikrlarimni bildirish imkoniyati uchun minnatdorman.

Shaxsan men, muvozanatli yondashuv eng foydali bo'ladi deb hisoblayman. Forma talabalar o'rtasida tenglikni ta'minlasa va kiyim borasidagi tengdoshlar bosimini kamaytirsa-da, juda qattiq siyosat cheklovchi bo'lib tuyulishi mumkin.

Haftada bir marta erkin kiyim kunlarini joriy etishni taklif qilaman. Bu talabalarga boshqa kunlarda formaning afzalliklarini saqlab qolgan holda, o'z individualligini ifoda etishga imkon beradi.

Bundan tashqari, ehtimol, formaning o'zi turli ob-havo sharoitlariga mos keladigan qulayroq variantlarni o'z ichiga olishi uchun yangilanishi mumkin.

Ushbu muhim masala bo'yicha talabalar fikrini ko'rib chiqayotganingiz uchun tashakkur.

Hurmat bilan,
Xavotirdagi Talaba

Misol uchun, forma noqulay bo'lishi mumkin, ayniqsa yozda. Shuningdek, o'quvchilar o'zlarini ifoda etish uchun ko'proq imkoniyatlarga ega bo'lishi kerak deb o'ylayman. Men oyiga bir marta "oddiy kiyim" kuni o'tkazishni taklif qilaman. Bu bizga o'z kiyimlarimizni kiyishga va shaxsiyatimizni ko'rsatishga imkon beradi. Biroq, men forma foydalarini ham tushunaman, masalan, zo'ravonlikning oldini olish va hamma aqlli ko'rinishini ta'minlash. Fikrimni tinglaganingiz uchun rahmat.
Hurmat bilan,
O'quvchi
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli Maktab Kengashi,
Men maktab formasi siyosatiga kiritilishi taklif etilayotgan o'zgarishlar yuzasidan o'z fikrimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Qattiq formani saqlab qolish foydasiga keltirilgan dalillarni tan olgan holda, menimcha, yanada erkin yondashuv oxir-oqibatda talabalar manfaatiga xizmat qiladi.
Mening fikrimcha, amaldagi siyosat individuallik va o'zini ifoda etishni bo'g'adi. Talabalarga vaqti-vaqti bilan o'z kiyimlarini kiyishga ruxsat berish, ehtimol, belgilangan "erkin juma" kunida, shaxsiy o'zlik va ijodkorlik tuyg'usini kuchaytiradi. Bundan tashqari, qat'iy forma ayrim faoliyatlar yoki ob-havo sharoitlari uchun noqulay va amaliy bo'lmasligi mumkin. Yanada moslashuvchan forma variantlarini taqdim etish yoki oqilona ko'rsatmalar doirasida o'zgartirishlarga ruxsat berish bu muammoni hal qiladi.
Albatta, odob-axloq tuyg'usini saqlab qolish va har qanday haddan tashqari yoki nomaqbul kiyimlarning oldini olish muhim. Biroq, menimcha, standartlarni saqlash va talabalarga o'zlarini ifoda etishga ruxsat berish o'rtasida muvozanatga erishish mumkin. Fikrimni inobatga olganingiz uchun tashakkur.
Hurmat bilan,
Xavotirda bo'lgan talaba
